title: ynf config
description: ynf's own configuration: which repositories it watches, where its state lives, and how it runs. Found at config.yaml in the home factory folder (~/.agents/factory/, or a fallback, ADR-009), or passed with --config.

repos.description: Enrolled repositories (owner/name), when there is no configuration repository. ynf reads each one's lanes from its default branch.

factory.description: The factory's configuration repository (ADR-006): its .agents/factory/factory.yaml enrols repositories, and its lanes.yaml is the default every enrolled repository's lanes are laid over. Instead of repos.

repo.description: owner/name, or host/owner/name naming the forge.

store.description: Where state lives: sqlite://<path> (relative to the config file's folder), s3://bucket/prefix or dynamodb://table. Default sqlite://state.db.

work_dir.description: Where repository mirrors and per-step worktrees live, relative to the config file's folder. Default work.

owner.description: This instance's name in leases. Default ynf@<hostname>/<pid>.

token_env.description: Environment variable holding the GitHub token ynf uses for the forge. Default GITHUB_TOKEN, falling back to `gh auth token`.

author.description: The git author of commits ynf writes. Default ynf <ynf@users.noreply.github.com>.

ci.description: How often a proposed item's checks are probed. Default 30s.

review.description: How often an item in review is probed for merge, close or review. Default 5m.

memory.description: Memory (ADR-008). Without this block ynf uses ynm when it is on PATH and nothing otherwise (ADR-012).

provider.description: ynm, or none to switch memory off even when ynm is installed.

namespace.description: The namespace a repository's memories go to; {repo} is owner/name. Default factory/{repo}.

context_budget_tokens.description: Tokens of memory added to a run's task. Default 1000.

cwd.description: The directory ynm runs as if from, which picks its store; relative to the config file. Default: where ynf runs.
